/* selectExcelDownload - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
C.EXCEL_DWNLD_NO AS EXCEL_DOWNLOAD_NO, C.EXCEL_FILE_NM AS EXPORT_TITLE,
(SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(H.URL_ADDR) IS NULL THEN C.MENU_URL_ADDR ELSE MAX(H.URL_ADDR) END FROM SAB200 G /* 메뉴 */, SAB100 H /* 프로그램 */ WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = H.PROGRM_ID AND G.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS MENU_URL,
C.PRVC_YN AS IS_PERSONAL_INFO, C.MENU_NO,
CASE WHEN C.MENU_NO = 0 THEN '메뉴 없음' ELSE (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.MENU_NM), '미정') FROM SAB200 D /* 메뉴 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) END AS MENU_NM,
CASE WHEN C.MENU_NO = 0 THEN '루트 메뉴 없음' ELSE (SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 F /* 메뉴 */ WHERE F.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH F.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR F.UP_MENU_NO = F.MENU_NO) END AS ROOT_MENU_NM
FROM SAB840 C /* 엑셀 다운로드 항목 */

/* selectExcelDownloadListCount - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM (
SELECT EXCEL_FILE_NM, MENU_NO, MENU_URL_ADDR AS MENU_URL, (SELECT H.URL_ADDR FROM SAB200 G /* 메뉴 */, SAB100 H /* 프로그램 */ WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = H.PROGRM_ID AND G.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS MENU_URL_ADDR, MENU_NM, UP_MENU_NM, DWNLD_CS_CN, FRST_RGTR_ID, C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(FRST_RGTR_ID) AS FRST_RGTR_NM, FRST_REG_DT
FROM SAB850 C /* 엑셀다운로드사유로그 */
) X
AND EXCEL_FILE_NM LIKE '%' || #{EXCEL_FILE_NM} || '%'
AND (MENU_URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{MENU_URL_ADDR} || '%' OR MENU_URL LIKE '%' || #{MENU_URL_ADDR} || '%')
AND MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || #{FRST_RGTR_ID} || '%'
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND (FRST_RGTR_NM = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{FRST_RGTR_NM}) OR FRST_RGTR_NM = '____' || #{FRST_RGTR_NM})

/* selectExcelDownloadList - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT EXCEL_FILE_NM, MENU_NO, MENU_URL, CASE WHEN MENU_URL_ADDR IS NULL THEN MENU_URL ELSE MENU_URL_ADDR END AS MENU_URL_ADDR, MENU_NM, UP_MENU_NM, DWNLD_CS_SE_CD, DWNLD_CS_CN, TELNO_NOCS, MBL_TELNO_NOCS, EML_NOCS, RRNO_NOCS, TOT_ROW_NOCS, CNTN_IP_ADDR, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_NM, TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FRST_REG_DT
FROM (
SELECT EXCEL_FILE_NM, MENU_NO, MENU_URL_ADDR AS MENU_URL, (SELECT H.URL_ADDR FROM SAB200 G /* 메뉴 */, SAB100 H /* 프로그램 */ WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = H.PROGRM_ID AND G.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS MENU_URL_ADDR, CASE WHEN MENU_NO = 0 THEN '메뉴 없음' ELSE MENU_NM END AS MENU_NM, CASE WHEN UP_MENU_NM IS NULL THEN '루트 메뉴 없음' ELSE UP_MENU_NM END AS UP_MENU_NM, DWNLD_CS_SE_CD, DWNLD_CS_CN, TELNO_NOCS, MBL_TELNO_NOCS, EML_NOCS, RRNO_NOCS, TOT_ROW_NOCS, CNTN_IP_ADDR, FRST_RGTR_ID, C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(FRST_RGTR_ID)) AS FRST_RGTR_NM, FRST_REG_DT
FROM SAB850 C /* 엑셀다운로드사유로그 */
) X
AND EXCEL_FILE_NM LIKE '%' || #{EXCEL_FILE_NM} || '%'
AND (MENU_URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{MENU_URL_ADDR} || '%' OR MENU_URL LIKE '%' || #{MENU_URL_ADDR} || '%')
AND MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || #{FRST_RGTR_ID} || '%'
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND (FRST_RGTR_NM = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{FRST_RGTR_NM}) OR FRST_RGTR_NM = '____' || #{FRST_RGTR_NM})
ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT DESC
OFFSET #{OFFSET_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

(SELECT
CASE WHEN E.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'WORKER' WHEN F.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN CASE F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD WHEN 'Y' THEN 'YOUTH' ELSE 'GUARDIAN' END ELSE '' END AS MEMBER_TYPE
FROM SCA300 D /* 개인정보 */ LEFT JOIN SCA100 E /* 종사자 */ ON D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = E.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN SCA200 F/* 청소년보호자 */ ON D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = F.INDV_IDNTFC_NO WHERE D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO) AS MEMBER_TYPE,
(SELECT G.USER_ID FROM SAA200 G /* 사용자 */ WHERE G.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO) AS USER_ID
FROM SCA300 C /* 개인정보 */
AND INDV_IDNTFC_NO = #{INDV_IDNTFC_NO}
AND FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{FLNM_ENCPT})
AND MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{MBL_TELNO_ENCPT})
AND RRNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{RRNO_ENCPT})
AND EML_ADDR_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{EML_ADDR_ENCPT})
AND MSNGR_ID_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{MSNGR_ID_ENCPT})
AND EXISTS (SELECT D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO FROM SAA200 D /* 사용자 */ WHERE D.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{USER_ID} || '%' AND D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO)
